scene: A prosperous merchant lives in a far-off country with his large family. Six sons and six daughters fill a grand household. Wealth and comfort surround them.
caption: "There lived a merchant who had been so fortunate in all his undertakings that he was enormously rich."

scene: The merchant's lavish home stands in all its glory. Children fill the rooms, accustomed to having every luxury. The household runs on wealth and excess.
caption: "He had six sons and six daughters, and found that his money was not too much to let them all have everything they fancied."

scene: A fierce fire engulfs the merchant's house. Flames consume everything — furniture, books, pictures, gold, silver, precious goods. The building collapses into ruin.
caption: "Their house caught fire and was speedily burnt to the ground, with all the splendid furniture, the books, pictures, gold, silver, and precious goods it contained."

scene: At sea, the merchant's ships are destroyed. Pirates attack, storms wreck vessels, fire consumes cargo. One disaster follows another across the waters.
caption: "He suddenly lost every ship he had upon the sea, either by dint of pirates, shipwreck, or fire."

scene: In distant countries, clerks once trusted by the merchant prove dishonest. They betray his trust and steal what remains of his fortune abroad.
caption: "His clerks in distant countries, whom he trusted entirely, had proved unfaithful."

scene: The merchant stands amidst ruin, stripped of everything. From enormous wealth, he has fallen into the direst poverty. Nothing remains of his former life.
caption: "At last from great wealth he fell into the direst poverty."

scene: A small, lonely house sits in a desolate place. It is at least a hundred leagues from the town where the merchant once lived. The house is humble and bare.
caption: "All that he had left was a little house in a desolate place at least a hundred leagues from the town in which he had lived."

scene: The merchant leads his children toward the lonely cottage. They carry what little they have left. The road stretches long and barren before them.
caption: "To this he was forced to retreat with his children, who were in despair at the idea of leading such a different life."

scene: The merchant's daughters clutch at memories of their former life. They hoped friends would take them in. But the invitations never come.
caption: "The daughters at first hoped that their friends, who had been so numerous while they were rich, would insist on their staying in their houses."

scene: The daughters stand alone, abandoned by former friends. No help arrives. The silence of desertion fills the air around them.
caption: "They soon found that they were left alone, and that their former friends even attributed their misfortunes to their own extravagance."

scene: Former friends turn their backs. They blame the family's extravagance for the ruin. No hand reaches out to help.
caption: "Their former friends showed no intention of offering them any help."

scene: The family arrives at a small cottage in the midst of a dark forest. The woods close in around them. The place seems the most dismal upon the face of the earth.
caption: "Nothing was left for them but to take their departure to the cottage, which stood in the midst of a dark forest."

scene: The dark forest surrounds the cottage on all sides. Towering trees block out the light. The cottage seems the most dismal place on earth.
caption: "The cottage seemed to be the most dismal place upon the face of the earth."

scene: The merchant's daughters scrub floors and haul water. Without servants, they work like peasant women. Their hands, once soft, grow rough.
caption: "As they were too poor to have any servants, the girls had to work hard, like peasants."

scene: The merchant's sons plow rough fields under open sky. They cultivate the earth to earn their living. Their fine clothes are replaced by rough garments.
caption: "The sons, for their part, cultivated the fields to earn their living."

scene: The family wears rough clothing and lives in the simplest way. The daughters stare at the bare walls, remembering luxuries. Amusements of former life seem a distant dream.
caption: "Roughly clothed, and living in the simplest way, the girls regretted unceasingly the luxuries and amusements of their former life."

scene: Among the daughters, one stands apart. The youngest does not despair. She alone tries to be brave and cheerful despite their ruin.
caption: "Only the youngest tried to be brave and cheerful."

scene: Beauty remembers the day misfortune struck. She was as sad as anyone when her father's ruin came. But her sadness did not last.
caption: "She had been as sad as anyone when misfortune overtook her father."

scene: Beauty's natural gaiety returns. She smiles and laughs, refusing to be crushed. Her spirit lifts like sunlight through clouds.
caption: "Soon recovering her natural gaiety, she set to work to make the best of things."

scene: Beauty entertains her father and brothers. She sings and tells stories, trying to lift their spirits. Her voice fills the small cottage with warmth.
caption: "She set to work to amuse her father and brothers as well as she could."

scene: Beauty turns to her sisters, inviting them to dance and sing with her. She reaches out her hands, hoping to join them in joy.
caption: "She tried to persuade her sisters to join her in dancing and singing."

scene: The elder sisters turn away from Beauty's invitation. They refuse to dance or sing. Their faces are stern and unyielding.
caption: "They would do nothing of the sort."

scene: The sisters look at Beauty with cold eyes. Because she is not as doleful as they are, they judge her. They declare this miserable life is all she is fit for.
caption: "Because she was not as doleful as themselves, they declared that this miserable life was all she was fit for."

scene: Beauty stands apart from her sisters, far prettier and cleverer than they. Her beauty outshines them, though they refuse to see it.
caption: "She was really far prettier and cleverer than they were."

scene: Beauty's lovely face and bright eyes catch the light. She is so beautiful that everyone who sees her calls her by one name.
caption: "She was so lovely that she was always called Beauty."

scene: The cottage sits quiet in the dark forest. Two years have passed. The family is beginning to get used to their new life of toil and simplicity.
caption: "After two years, when they were all beginning to get used to their new life, something happened to disturb their tranquillity."

scene: A messenger arrives at the cottage door. The merchant receives news that a ship, believed lost, has come safely into port. Rich cargo fills its hold.
caption: "Their father received the news that one of his ships, which he had believed to be lost, had come safely into port with a rich cargo."

scene: The sons and daughters leap with joy. They cry out that poverty is at an end. Their eyes shine with the promise of wealth again.
caption: "All the sons and daughters at once thought that their poverty was at an end."

scene: The children clamor to go to town immediately. They imagine fine clothes and gaiety once more. Excitement fills the small cottage.
caption: "They wanted to set out directly for the town."

scene: The merchant raises his hand for calm. He is more prudent than his children. He begs them to wait a little before rushing to town.
caption: "Their father, who was more prudent, begged them to wait a little."

scene: Though it is harvest time and he can ill be spared, the merchant resolves to go himself. He will make inquiries before the family commits to the journey.
caption: "Though it was harvest time, and he could ill be spared, he determined to go himself first, to make inquiries."

scene: Beauty alone holds doubt. She does not share her sisters' certainty. She suspects the news may not bring the wealth they imagine.
caption: "Only the youngest daughter had any doubt but that they would soon again be as rich as they were before."

scene: Beauty imagines returning to a town, finding amusement and gay companions once more. Her sisters dream of jewels and fine things. Beauty dreams only of comfort.
caption: "At least rich enough to live comfortably in some town where they would find amusement and gay companions once more."

scene: The sisters crowd around their departing father, loading him with commissions. They demand jewels and dresses that would cost a fortune. Their voices pile request upon request.
caption: "They all loaded their father with commissions for jewels and dresses which it would have taken a fortune to buy."

scene: Beauty stands apart from her sisters. She feels sure nothing will come of the journey. She does not ask for anything at all.
caption: "Only Beauty, feeling sure that it was of no use, did not ask for anything."

scene: The merchant notices Beauty's silence among her sisters' demands. He turns to her, waiting. She has said nothing while others pile on requests.
caption: "Her father, noticing her silence, said: 'And what shall I bring for you, Beauty?'"

scene: Beauty looks at her father with love. She asks for nothing but his safe return. Her voice is gentle and sincere.
caption: "'The only thing I wish for is to see you come home safely,' she answered."

scene: The elder sisters scowl at Beauty's words. They fancy she is blaming them for their costly requests. Their faces twist with resentment.
caption: "This only vexed her sisters, who fancied she was blaming them for having asked for such costly things."

scene: The merchant smiles at Beauty's answer. He is pleased by her kindness. But he thinks a girl her age should like pretty presents.
caption: "Her father was pleased, but as he thought that at her age she certainly ought to like pretty presents, he told her to choose something."

scene: Beauty hesitates, then speaks. She begs her father to bring her a rose. She has not seen one since they came to this desolate place.
caption: "'Well, dear father,' she said, 'as you insist upon it, I beg that you will bring me a rose.'"

scene: Beauty's eyes soften at the thought of roses. She loves them so much. She has not seen a single one since leaving her former life.
caption: "'I have not seen one since we came here, and I love them so much.'"

scene: The merchant mounts his horse and rides toward the town. He travels as quickly as possible, eager to reach the port and claim his cargo.
caption: "The merchant set out and reached the town as quickly as possible."

scene: In the town, the merchant discovers betrayal. His former companions, believing him dead, have divided the goods among themselves. Nothing remains for him.
caption: "Only to find that his former companions, believing him to be dead, had divided between them the goods which the ship had brought."

scene: Six months pass in trouble and expense. The merchant searches and fights for what is his. At the end, he is as poor as when he started.
caption: "After six months of trouble and expense he found himself as poor as when he started."

scene: The merchant can recover only enough money to pay the cost of his journey home. He has nothing left for his family. Despair fills his heart.
caption: "Having been able to recover only just enough to pay the cost of his journey."

scene: The merchant leaves the town in the most terrible weather. Wind howls and snow falls. The road becomes a treacherous path through the storm.
caption: "He was obliged to leave the town in the most terrible weather."

scene: The merchant rides through snow and ice, nearing home at last. But he is almost exhausted with cold and fatigue. His strength fails him.
caption: "By the time he was within a few leagues of his home he was almost exhausted with cold and fatigue."

scene: The merchant knows the forest will take hours to cross. But his longing to reach home overrides caution. He resolves to press on through the woods.
caption: "Though he knew it would take some hours to get through the forest, he was so anxious to be at his journey's end that he resolved to go on."

scene: Darkness falls over the forest. Night overtakes the merchant on the road. The path disappears beneath deepening snow.
caption: "But night overtook him."

scene: Deep snow and bitter frost blanket the forest. The merchant's horse stumbles and can go no further. The animal is spent.
caption: "The deep snow and bitter frost made it impossible for his horse to carry him any further."

scene: The merchant scans the darkness in every direction. Not a house is to be seen. Only trees and snow stretch to the horizon.
caption: "Not a house was to be seen."

scene: The merchant finds the hollow trunk of a great tree. It is his only shelter from the bitter cold. He crawls inside its dark cavity.
caption: "The only shelter he could get was the hollow trunk of a great tree."

scene: Inside the hollow tree, the merchant crouches through the longest night of his life. Cold seeps into his bones. The darkness seems endless.
caption: "There he crouched all the night which seemed to him the longest he had ever known."

scene: The wolves howl in the forest around him. Their cries pierce the night. The merchant cannot sleep despite his weariness.
caption: "In spite of his weariness the howling of the wolves kept him awake."

scene: At last dawn breaks over the frozen forest. But the merchant finds no relief. Snow has covered every path and trail.
caption: "Even when at last the day broke he was not much better off, for the falling snow had covered up every path."

scene: The merchant stands lost in the white wilderness. He does not know which way to turn. The forest offers no guidance.
caption: "He did not know which way to turn."

scene: After wandering, the merchant makes out some sort of track through the snow. It is faint and uncertain, but it is something to follow.
caption: "At length he made out some sort of track."

scene: The track is rough and slippery. The merchant falls down more than once as he struggles forward. The ice catches his feet.
caption: "At the beginning it was so rough and slippery that he fell down more than once."

scene: The track grows easier under his feet. It leads forward through the snow. Hope stirs in the merchant's heart.
caption: "It presently became easier, and led him into an avenue of trees which ended in a splendid castle."

scene: The track opens into an avenue of trees. At its end stands a splendid castle. The merchant stares in wonder at its grandeur.
caption: "It presently became easier, and led him into an avenue of trees which ended in a splendid castle."

scene: Snow has not fallen in the avenue. The trees are entirely composed of orange trees. They are covered with flowers and fruit, impossibly alive in winter.
caption: "It seemed to the merchant very strange that no snow had fallen in the avenue, which was entirely composed of orange trees, covered with flowers and fruit."

scene: The merchant reaches the first court of the castle. Before him rises a flight of agate steps. The stone gleams with color.
caption: "When he reached the first court of the castle he saw before him a flight of agate steps."

scene: The merchant ascends the agate steps and passes through several splendidly furnished rooms. Warmth fills the air. The rooms are silent and inviting.
caption: "He went up them, and passed through several splendidly furnished rooms, warm and silent."

scene: The merchant enters a large hall. A cheerful fire burns on the hearth. A table is laid with a single cover, waiting for a guest.
caption: "At last he reached a large hall, where a cheerful fire was burning and a table laid with a single cover."

scene: Every dish on the table is made of gold. The merchant has never seen such a dainty supper. The food steams with warmth and fragrance.
caption: "All the dishes were of gold, though the merchant thought that he had never seen such a dainty supper."

scene: The merchant waits a long time for his host. The fire crackles. The food stays warm. Silence fills the hall.
caption: "However, he waited for a long time."

scene: The clock strikes twelve. The sound echoes through the silent castle. The hour has come.
caption: "Till the clock struck twelve, when a strange figure appeared."

scene: A strange figure materializes in the hall. It is none other than the Beast. His form is terrible and inhuman.
caption: "When a strange figure appeared, which was none other than the Beast."

scene: The Beast starts at the sight of the merchant. He is startled to find an intruder in his castle. He turns away in shock.
caption: "The Beast was so much startled at the sight of the merchant that he hastily turned away."

scene: The Beast recovers himself. He turns back to face the merchant. His voice is terrible as he speaks.
caption: "But, recovering himself, he said, in a terrible voice: 'Who are you, and how did you dare to enter my castle?'"

scene: The Beast accuses the merchant. He asks if he has come seeking his daughter. He declares she belongs to him.
caption: "'Have you come to seek your daughter? She is not here; she belongs to me.'"

scene: The merchant trembles with terror before the Beast. He tells how he lost his way in the snow. He begs for mercy.
caption: "The merchant, trembling with terror, told the Beast how he had lost his way and begged for mercy."

scene: The Beast promises mercy and food. He tells the merchant his daughter came of her own free will. She will not be sent back.
caption: "'I will give you mercy and food,' said the Beast, 'for your daughter has come of her own free will. But I will not send her back.'"

scene: The Beast commands the merchant. He must go home and bring one of his daughters. The Beast does not care which one, but she must come willingly.
caption: "'You must go home yourself, and bring me one of your daughters. I do not care which one, but she must come willingly.'"

scene: The Beast delivers his threat. If the daughter does not come of her own will, the Beast will come and fetch her himself.
caption: "'If she does not come, I will come and fetch her.'"

scene: The merchant is grief-stricken at the thought of bringing a daughter to this place. But he does not dare refuse. He accepts the offer of food and shelter for the night.
caption: "The merchant, grief-stricken at the thought of bringing one of his daughters to such a place, yet not daring to refuse, accepted the offer of food and shelter for the night."

scene: Morning light fills the castle hall. The merchant prepares to leave. The Beast gives him money sufficient to support his family for several months.
caption: "Next morning he set out on his homeward journey, after the Beast had given him a sum of money sufficient to support his family for several months."

scene: The merchant arrives home. His children rush out to meet him. Joyous cries fill the air as they surround him.
caption: "When he arrived home, his children surrounded him with joyous cries."

scene: The merchant tells his children of his adventure at the castle. He reveals that one of them must go to the Beast. The words hang heavy in the room.
caption: "But when he told them of his adventure, and that one of them must go to the Beast, their grief was terrible."

scene: The children cry out in horror. Their grief is terrible at the thought of the Beast. Tears stream down their faces.
caption: "Their grief was terrible."

scene: Among the weeping family, Beauty alone is calm. She does not cry or protest. A quiet resolve settles over her face.
caption: "Beauty alone was calm."

scene: Beauty steps forward and speaks to her father. She entreats him to let her go to the Beast. Her voice is steady.
caption: "She entreated her father to let her go."

scene: The two eldest sisters rage at Beauty's offer. They are furious that she would volunteer. Their faces burn with anger.
caption: "The two eldest sisters were furious."

scene: The sisters accuse Beauty of wanting to be rid of them. They say she is acting the part of a heroine. Their words are sharp and cruel.
caption: "They accused Beauty of wishing to get rid of them, and of acting the part of a heroine."

scene: The merchant's heart breaks at the thought of losing Beauty. He resolves to go alone to the Beast, sparing all his daughters. His face is lined with grief.
caption: "The merchant, heart-broken at the thought of losing Beauty, at last resolved to go alone."

scene: Beauty insists on going to the Beast. She will not let her father go alone. She stands firm in her decision.
caption: "But Beauty insisted on going, and at last he was forced to consent."

scene: The whole family walks together to the gate of the castle. Father and daughter side by side. The children follow in silence.
caption: "The whole family accompanied the merchant and Beauty to the gate of the castle."

scene: At the castle gate, Beauty and her family share many tender farewells. They embrace and weep. Each goodbye is longer than the last.
caption: "Here, after many tender farewells, Beauty entered alone."

scene: Beauty turns and passes through the castle gate. She walks alone into the unknown. Her family watches from outside.
caption: "Here, after many tender farewells, Beauty entered alone."

scene: As soon as Beauty is inside, the door closes behind her. The sound echoes through the hall. She is sealed within the castle.
caption: "As soon as she was inside, the door was closed behind her."

scene: Beauty finds herself in a great hall. The room is vast and warm. Shadows dance on the walls from unseen light.
caption: "When she found herself in a great hall."

scene: A table is spread with every kind of food. Roasts, fruits, breads, and delicacies fill every dish. The feast is magnificent.
caption: "She saw a table spread with every kind of food."

scene: Beauty is very hungry. She sits down at the table and eats. The food is warm and satisfying.
caption: "As she was very hungry she sat down and ate."

scene: A great noise echoes through the hall. Something approaches. Beauty's heart beats fast with fear.
caption: "Then she heard a great noise, and the Beast appeared."

scene: The Beast appears before Beauty. His form is so frightful that she nearly faints with terror. His face is terrible to behold.
caption: "He was so frightful that Beauty nearly fainted with terror."

scene: The Beast speaks to Beauty. His voice is terrible, but not unkind. There is a strange gentleness beneath the horror.
caption: "But he spoke to her in a voice which, though terrible, was not unkind."

scene: The Beast asks Beauty if she has come of her own free will. His eyes search her face. The question hangs in the air.
caption: "And said: 'Good-evening, Beauty. Have you come of your own free will?'"

scene: Beauty answers the Beast. She trembles as she speaks, but her voice holds. She tells him she has come willingly.
caption: "She answered, trembling, that she had."

scene: The Beast tells Beauty she is very kind. He says he fears she is lonely here. He offers to show her around the castle.
caption: "'You are very kind,' said the Beast; 'but I am afraid you are lonely here. Will you show you around the castle?'"

scene: Beauty follows the Beast through several splendid rooms. They are all hung with silk and gold. The walls shimmer with richness.
caption: "Beauty then followed him through several splendid rooms, all hung with silk and gold."

scene: They come to a chamber where a most wonderful music-box sits. It is ornate and beautiful. Its mechanism waits to be awakened.
caption: "At last they came to a chamber where there was a most wonderful music-box."

scene: The Beast tells Beauty she may open the music-box. She may listen to the music. It will help to pass away the time.
caption: "'You may open it,' said the Beast, 'and listen to the music. It will help to pass away the time.'"

scene: They come to a door on which words are written in gold. The inscription reads "Beauty's room." This chamber is hers alone.
caption: "At last they came to a door on which was written: 'Beauty's room.'"

scene: Beauty enters the room and finds a charming apartment. It is warm and inviting. Everything has been prepared for her comfort.
caption: "She entered, and found a charming apartment."

scene: A couch of white satin sits in the center of the room. It is soft and luxurious. A place of rest awaits her.
caption: "With a couch of white satin."

scene: A mirror hangs in the room. In it Beauty can see herself from head to foot. Her reflection stares back at her.
caption: "And a mirror in which she could see herself from head to foot."

scene: On a table rests a book. Gold letters shine upon its cover. The words promise her power and service.
caption: "On a table was a book, on which was written in gold letters: 'I am your slave, and you are my queen. Ask what you will, and it shall be granted.'"

scene: Beauty opens a door and discovers a library filled with books. Shelves rise from floor to ceiling. Knowledge and stories surround her.
caption: "Beauty opened the door, and found a library filled with books."

scene: Beauty takes a book from the shelf. She begins to read. The pages turn under her fingers.
caption: "She took one, and began to read."

scene: Beauty reads for a long time, absorbed in the book. She finds it very interesting. The hours pass unnoticed.
caption: "She found it very interesting, and spent a long time in the library."

scene: Beauty goes into the garden. Flowers of every color bloom around her. The garden is full of the most beautiful flowers.
caption: "Then she went into the garden, which was full of the most beautiful flowers."

scene: Beauty walks among the flowers for some time. She breathes in their fragrance. Then she returns to her room.
caption: "She walked about for some time, and then returned to her room."

scene: Every day the Beast comes to see Beauty. He arrives at the same hour. His visits become a routine.
caption: "Every day the Beast came to see her, and they spent the evening together."

scene: Beauty and the Beast spend the evening together. They talk and sit by the fire. A strange companionship forms.
caption: "Every day the Beast came to see her, and they spent the evening together."

scene: The Beast asks Beauty if she will marry him. His voice is hopeful. The question comes as it always does.
caption: "He always asked her if she would marry him."

scene: Beauty says no. She has refused before and refuses again. Her answer is always the same.
caption: "And she always said no."

scene: Months pass. Beauty begins to feel sorry for the Beast. She sees his loneliness. Pity grows in her heart.
caption: "At last, after many months, Beauty began to feel sorry for the Beast, and to pity him."

scene: One day Beauty looks into the mirror. She sees her father at home, ill and suffering. His face is pale and drawn.
caption: "One day she saw in a mirror that her father was ill."

scene: Beauty begs the Beast to let her go home. Tears fill her eyes as she pleads. She must see her father.
caption: "And she begged the Beast to let her go home to see him."

scene: The Beast agrees to let Beauty go. But he sets a condition. She must return within a week.
caption: "The Beast agreed, on condition that she would return in a week."

scene: Beauty promises to return. She gives her word. The Beast accepts her promise.
caption: "Beauty promised."

scene: The next morning, Beauty finds herself back in her father's cottage. She has been transported home. The Beast's magic has carried her.
caption: "And the next morning she found herself in her father's cottage."

scene: The Beast had given Beauty a box of gold before she left. She carries it now into her father's house. Riches sit before the family.
caption: "The Beast had given her a box of gold."

scene: The whole family is overjoyed to see Beauty. They surround her with embraces and tears. Joy fills the cottage.
caption: "The whole family was overjoyed to see her."

scene: The two sisters look at Beauty's fine clothes and wealth. Jealousy burns in their eyes. They cannot hide their envy.
caption: "Her two sisters were jealous of her fine clothes and her wealth."

scene: The sisters whisper together in the corner. They plot to keep Beauty beyond the week. Their scheme is dark and cruel.
caption: "And they plotted to keep her beyond the week."

scene: The sisters imagine the Beast's anger. They hope he will kill Beauty for breaking her promise. Their malice runs deep.
caption: "So that the Beast would be angry and kill her."

scene: Beauty, always good and kind, refuses to listen to her sisters' plans. She will not be persuaded to break her word. Her conscience is clear.
caption: "But Beauty, who was always good and kind, refused to listen to their plans."

scene: At the end of the week, Beauty keeps her promise. She returns to the castle. The door opens for her as before.
caption: "And at the end of the week she returned to the castle."

scene: Beauty arrives at the castle. She finds the Beast lying on the grass. He is weak and still.
caption: "When she arrived, she found the Beast lying on the grass."

scene: The Beast lies on the grass, and he seems to be dying. His breath is shallow. His great form is diminished.
caption: "He seemed to be dying."

scene: The Beast looks up at Beauty. He tells her she forgot her promise. His voice is faint.
caption: "'You forgot your promise,' he said."

scene: The Beast tells Beauty he has been dying of grief. His heart broke waiting for her. His suffering has been great.
caption: "'And I have been dying of grief.'"

scene: The Beast forgives Beauty. There is no anger in his voice. Only love and pain.
caption: "'But I forgive you.'"

scene: The Beast asks Beauty one final time if she will marry him. His voice is barely a whisper. His eyes plead.
caption: "'Will you marry me?'"

scene: Beauty has grown to love the Beast. She sees his kindness, his patience, his pain. Her heart has changed.
caption: "Beauty, who had grown to love the Beast."

scene: At last Beauty consents. She says the word that will change everything. Her voice is soft but sure.
caption: "At last consented."

scene: As soon as Beauty speaks, the Beast disappears. In his place stands a handsome prince. Light surrounds the transformation.
caption: "As soon as she had spoken the words, the Beast disappeared, and in his place stood a handsome prince."

scene: The prince stands before Beauty, tall and noble. He is no longer the Beast. His face is kind and handsome.
caption: "In his place stood a handsome prince."

scene: The prince explains that a fairy enchanted him. He could only be restored by the love of a good and beautiful maiden. Beauty has broken the spell.
caption: "'I have been enchanted by a fairy,' he explained, 'and could only be restored to my own form by the love of a good and beautiful maiden.'"

scene: The prince tells Beauty she has broken the spell. He is now himself again. His true form is restored.
caption: "'You have broken the spell, and I am now myself again.'"

scene: The prince and Beauty stand together. They are married in a joyous ceremony. Love surrounds them.
caption: "The prince and Beauty were married."

scene: The prince and Beauty live together in happiness. Their days are filled with joy and love. The castle is full of light.
caption: "And they lived happily ever after."
